text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature and I come to the shrine to
wish for
success in her upcoming senior
year.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's write that thingy—the one
you hang
on the rack.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's important to write wishes down. You
don't
want to get in a divine argument
about what you
said and what you
didn't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do as she suggests and write my wish
down. My
wish is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under any circumstances, health is
wealth. I wish
for Nice Nature's good
health so that she can run
throughout
the year.
choice_data_list: ナイスネイチャが健康でありますように
ナイスネイチャがもっと強くなれますように
ナイスネイチャの特技が増えますように

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She still needs to be stronger to make
her dreams
come true. I wish for the
future she desires to
have.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature has become capable of so
many
things now. I wish for her further
growth.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You sure took your time writing that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I get it, you're at the age where you start
to have
many concerns.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I bet you wished for your back pain to
disappear
or for better sleep, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then... for a bigger paycheck? For a
house? What
was it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: 君のことをお願いしてた
貴方のことをお願いしてた

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Your wish was about me? Uhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You don't... have to care so much about
me on
holidays.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You have your own life too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: T-top priority?! Me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You always do this... I bet you don't
even care
how I feel hearing that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay! My success, huh? All right! That's
a pretty
hefty demand, but I'll try!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah! Right. The Arima Kinen...
choice_data_list: 大きな目標もあるしな
大きな目標もあるしね

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's... another hefty goal. I really
do need
to work hard.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...At some point, we should visit the
Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I remember Nice Nature was
talking to
two members of the Mejiro
family after the Arima
Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We'll show you something more
affirmative than
words. That will
probably be all you need.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I think that "something" is the clue for
what will
make me faster.
